approach: Static recompilation of the XBE to C with xboxrecomp; NV2A pushbuffers drawn by a Direct3D 11 back end (up to 4x, widescreen), CPU rasteriser as fallback
help: Light-glow flicker on the GPU renderer
notes: Plays full matches start to finish. GPU renderer (Direct3D 11) at up to 4x the Xbox resolution, in the game's own 16:9 mode; the game's movies play in the window. Title card with settings, F10 overlay (live render resolution, AF, sharpening, FXAA), controller with rumble, keyboard. The download needs your own North American disc (v3): the first start copies the game from your .iso. Next: flicker and texture glitches, testing on more GPUs.
